Your salary comes in, and within the first few days of the month, a huge part of it is already gone towards rent, EMIs, SIPs, credit card bills, and everyday expenses. If this sounds familiar, you are not alone. In this video, I explain why millions of salaried Indians are living remarkably similar financial lives, with stagnant salaries, rising rents, growing EMIs, lifestyle pressure, and increasingly expensive aspirations.
